# Enterprise Knowledge Copilot

> A role-aware RAG copilot over the public GitLab Handbook plus clearly labelled
> synthetic confidential documents. Answers cite the passage they came from and
> refuse when the evidence is weak. Access control is enforced in SQL, not after
> retrieval.

## What it is

- Live web app: https://enterprise-knowledge-copilot-wine.vercel.app
- API: https://enterprise-knowledge-copilot-2u57.onrender.com (health at /health)
- Source: https://github.com/ibrahimSumon47/Enterprise-Knowledge-Copilot

## How it works

1. The question is classified (policy, compensation, security, unclear).
2. Hybrid retrieval runs inside Postgres: pgvector similarity plus full-text,
   fused with reciprocal rank fusion. The caller's role and department are part
   of the SQL predicate, so unauthorised passages never leave the database.
3. An ONNX cross-encoder can rerank the candidates where memory allows.
4. The model answers only from the numbered passages and must cite each claim.
5. Every citation is verified against the retrieved chunks; weak evidence or an
   uncited sentence produces an explicit refusal.

## Access model

- guest: public
- employee: public + employee
- engineering / security / hr / finance: public + employee + own department
- admin: everything, including the synthetic confidential set

## Corpus and licences

GitLab Handbook content under CC BY-SA 4.0, with source URL, licence and
attribution stored per chunk. Confidential documents are synthetic and marked
`synthetic` in metadata and in the UI.

## Pages

- / — overview and access matrix
- /login — role accounts (password held by the owner)
- /chat — ask a question, read answers with citations
- /trust — controls linked to the code that implements them
- /evals — evaluation metrics and current status
- /credits — corpus and model attribution
- /.well-known/security.txt — disclosure policy
